note: Set A stays close to the wiring schedule and title block, correctly binding symbol numbers (31, 32, 33, 34, 50, 150) to their CU/AL materials, conductor configurations and conduit sizes, plus the revision and copyright data. Set B captures a few useful facts (NFDS enclosure, 151 armored cable, connection to main service panel) but invents or misreads several values: '100A' and '20A' are not on the page, the quote 'NEMA ENCLOSURE, SNAP MAIN BREAKER' is fabricated, '60A DC MIDS' misreads NFDS and cites the wrong note, and components 7 and 50 are mislabeled as disconnects. A's weaker claims are a few vague component-2/20 connection claims and a misbound 'PV Equipment quantity 50', but it has far fewer substantive errors than B.
